product.summary: Ronin Wallet browser extension for managing Ronin and supported assets from desktop browsers.
product.notes: The extension is modeled separately from Ronin Mobile because browser and mobile runtimes have distinct distribution and security lifecycles. Current first-party documentation supports Chrome, Edge and Firefox; initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Ronin Wallet Desktop Guide
evidence.notes: Current first-party desktop guide explicitly distributes Ronin Wallet Extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox, supporting the separate browser-extension product boundary.
